prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: The parent's critical-pair Laplacian (c032, +0.123) is the only mechanism that paid off, but its gain concentrated on C1 while C3's crit_cross rose; halving the Laplacian coefficient (0.6→0.3) keeps the critical-locality benefit on C1 while letting the fan-out-damped cut dominate again on C3, improving robustness across circuits.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=+0.038 robust(mean-std)=-0.010 min_case=-0.012 seed_std=0.018 tns_mean=+0.014 all_valid=True
  C1: score=+0.042 dWNS=+8.4% dTNS=+1.7% per-seed=[+0.06 -0.00 +0.07]
  C2: score=+0.008 dWNS=-0.9% dTNS=+2.4% per-seed=[+0.01 +0.00 +0.01]
  C3: score=-0.012 dWNS=-2.1% dTNS=+0.2% per-seed=[-0.02 +0.01 -0.04]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->139, wcut 421->423, crit_cross 0.011->0.011, repair_flips 103->103, changed-vs-baseline 2.9%
  C2: cut 318->313, wcut 1007->985, crit_cross 0.000->0.000, repair_flips 238->241, changed-vs-baseline 3.1%
  C3: cut 582->580, wcut 1955->1950, crit_cross 0.069->0.073, repair_flips 353->345, changed-vs-baseline 1.6%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response:
(1) Partially. Halving the Laplacian kept C1's gain (+0.042, dWNS +8.4%) but did not restore C3: score still -0.012, dWNS -2.1%, and crit_cross rose 0.069→0.073, so the C3 critical-cross regression persists rather than being damped by the cut term.

(2) C1: cut 137→139, wcut 421→423, crit_cross flat, repair_flips flat — gain is timing-driven, not cut-driven. C2: cut 318→313, wcut 1007→985, flips 238→241 — mild cut win. C3: cut 582→580, wcut 1955→1950, flips 353→345, but crit_cross up — cut improved while critical locality worsened.

(3) Seed spread: C1 [0.06,-0.00,+0.07] and C3 [-0.02,+0.01,-0.04] are wide; robust mean-std -0.010 and min_case -0.012 indicate fragility, not acceptable.

(4) Next: sweep coefficient 0.3→0.45 and add a C3-specific crit_cross penalty term, evaluating per-seed variance before accepting.
